events.title: BTC dipped below $80,000 in the last 24 hours (low $75,736) and recovered

messages.text:
**Daily Market Summary · 5 November 2026**

**Alert**
• BTC dipped below $80,000 in the last 24 hours (low $75,736) and recovered. It matters because the dip came close to the $76,816 30-day low but did not hold.

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $80,768, up about 3.6% over 7 days.
• Headline: BULLISH, high confidence. The long-run uptrend holds, but price is still just under its 50-day average.
• Fear & Greed 50 (neutral), up from 34 a day earlier. Price swings are still unusually calm.

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Bitcoin dipped to about $75,736, then rose back above $81,000 on the same day US stocks rose broadly after the US midterm result (PANews). No single cause is reported.
• About $913 million of bets were forced to close in 24 hours, mostly bets on a fall ($554 million) (CoinGlass via PANews).
• US Bitcoin funds saw about $487 million leave in the latest day.

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
Soft to neutral: price has closed under its 50-day average for 15 days, about 2% below it.
• Turns up: a close above $82,111 (the 50-day average), then $84,012 (the 30-day high).
• Sideways: $79,000-$82,111; a normal week swings about $3,352.
• Turns down: a close below $79,000, then $76,816 (the 30-day low).
• Rally watch: quiet. A rally window opens above $84,231 and a drop signal starts below $71,753.
• This week: US jobs report on 6 November. Next Fed meeting: 8 December.

**News that matters**
• Democrats won both houses of the US Congress; the pending US crypto rules bill expires on 3 January 2027 unless it gets 60 Senate votes (The Block and Bitcoin.com via PANews): medium term, moderate negative.
• Stripe now lets US businesses pay people in digital dollars to crypto wallets in over 160 markets (The Defiant via PANews): long term, moderate positive.
• Binance says it has replaced about 98% of the stolen coins; Mercado Bitcoin plans to reopen from 9 November (PANews): short term, small positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Trump-linked tokens fell after the election, TRUMP down about 18% in a day (Bloomberg via PANews); INJ rose about 11% after Nasdaq approved a staked INJ fund listing (PANews).
• New on Reku: Re says deposits in its reUSD digital dollar passed $400 million (according to the project).

**Bigger picture**
• Next month: mixed, and it firms up only if price wins back $82,111. 3-6 months: leans up while price holds above $73,222 (the 200-day average).

Keep normal spend with a small, pausable increase toward active traders, in line with the scale-up posture: no rally or drop window is open and Bitcoin is still just under its 50-day average. Lead creatives with trust and everyday use (Stripe's digital-dollar payouts) rather than price-move hooks. Speed up once price closes back above $82,111, and have rally creatives ready to go live if Bitcoin closes above about $84,231.

Keep the normal posting rhythm with a daily recap: Bitcoin around $80,768, up about 4% over the week, this week's normal zone $79,000-$82,111, no prediction. Add a plain explainer on the US election result: Democrats won both houses and the pending US crypto rules bill expires on 3 January 2027 unless it gets 60 Senate votes (PANews). Update the safety post with Binance replacing about 98% of stolen coins and Mercado Bitcoin reopening from 9 November.

Keep the regular lifecycle messages; no rally or drop window is open, so no promotional push. Send existing users a short, calm note on what the US election means for crypto rules, plus a safety reminder while exchange thefts are still in the news. Keep the onboarding journey queued: new sign-ups tend to arrive 2-4 weeks after a rally, and a rally window opens above about $84,231.

Pintu, Indodax and Pluang are all publishing on three live themes today:
• **US midterm result and crypto rules** (all three, e.g. Indodax's 'Demokrat Unggul di Hasil Pemilu Sela AS 2026'): publish a plain 'what the new US Congress means for crypto' page with the 3 January 2027 deadline; likely to draw searches because the result is fresh.
• **Exchange safety after the Binance theft** (all three, e.g. Pintu on Binance reopening withdrawals): refresh the 'how to keep crypto safe' guide with Binance's 98% replacement update.
• **Tokenized US shares** (all three, e.g. Pluang on the first tokenized US stock trade under the SEC exemption): publish 'what is a tokenized stock'.
Check each against Reku's pages. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

Hot themes today: Trump-linked tokens fell after the Democratic win, with TRUMP down about 18% in a day and Trump Media shares at a record low (Bloomberg via PANews). Stripe's digital-dollar payouts to wallets in 160+ markets keep stablecoins in focus (The Defiant via PANews), and INJ rose about 11% after Nasdaq approved a staked INJ fund listing (PANews). Shares in token form also moved ahead after a US court let single-stock contracts proceed (PANews).
New on Reku: Re says deposits in its reUSD digital dollar passed $400 million, and Babylon says Cradle is building an options app on its Bitcoin vaults (both according to the projects). PONS rose about 13% in a day with no stated reason.
